title: OpenLifeModel PersonProfile 0.1
description: Canonical personal inputs that OLM 0.1 models may reference. Every field except age and sex is optional; models decide how to treat missing values.

sex.description: Sex as recorded in the baseline mortality data.

smoking_status.description: Cigarette smoking history. Former smokers should give the age they quit when known; use "former" only if it is not.

systolic_bp.description: Resting systolic blood pressure in mmHg.

mvpa_minutes_per_week.description: Leisure-time moderate-to-vigorous physical activity, in moderate-equivalent minutes per week: each minute of vigorous activity counts as two.

alcohol_drinks_per_week.description: Standard alcoholic drinks per week (one drink ≈ 14 g of ethanol).
